title: About Fannie Mae & Freddie Mac
notes: Institutional overview of enterprise mortgage purchase and securitization roles. No product eligibility inferred.

title: The Loan We All Own
notes: Institutional description of the Delegated Underwriting and Servicing lender model. Verify program requirements in the applicable Guide.

title: Contact Multifamily
notes: Identifies the Optigo lender network and purchase channel. No unit count or minimum loan size used.

title: Office of Multifamily Housing Production
publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
notes: HUD identifies its oversight of FHA multifamily insurance origination and directs readers to MAP-approved lenders. No specific product eligibility is asserted.

title: Form of Pooling and Servicing Agreement, Exhibit 4.1
publisher: Santander Commercial Mortgage Securities LLC, filed on SEC EDGAR
notes: Filed form with party and series placeholders. Article II addresses loan conveyance and certificate issuance. Article III, including sections 3.01, 3.02, 3.19 and 3.20, illustrates loan administration, transfer and controls on delegation. It is neither an executed agreement for the fictional loan nor an SEC rule.

title: Policy Statement on Prudent Commercial Real Estate Loan Accommodations and Workouts
publisher: OCC, Federal Reserve Board, FDIC and NCUA
notes: Final policy statement, 88 FR 43115. Scope is institutions supervised by the issuing agencies. No specific remedy, borrower right or CMBS authority inferred.

title: Multifamily Selling and Servicing Guide, Chapter 13, Supplemental Mortgage Loans
notes: Part III, Chapter 13 §§1302.03A–D in the June 2, 2026 edition cover the lowest applicable sizing result, prescribed amortizing debt service, combined DSCR and LTV inputs, and a conditional New Loan Test. Section A prints 1402.03.B–D even though Chapter 13 labels the following provisions 1302.03B–D. The article teaches from the dated edition and gives no current threshold or eligibility conclusion.

title: Uniform Supplemental Financing Checklist
notes: Form dated November 2024. Part III records combined ratios and references the limits in the senior loan documents and reported values in the supplemental commitment. The form alone does not establish current eligibility.

title: BANK5 2026-5YR24 Primary Servicing Agreement, Exhibit 4.21
publisher: Midland Loan Services and Trimont LLC, filed on SEC EDGAR
notes: Agreement dated as of August 1, 2026. Section 3.01(b) and (c)(14), (25)–(27) support continuing payment processing, consent routing and limits on delegation for this transaction.

title: Multifamily Selling and Servicing Guide, Section 203, Pre-Review Mortgage Loans
notes: Part I, Chapter 2, Section 203 concerns Pre-Review and loans that are not fully delegated. Supports the distinction between delegated and escalated decisions for this program.

title: Investor Bulletin: Publicly Traded REITs
publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Office of Investor Education and Advocacy
notes: Supports the introductory distinction between holding shares in a REIT and directly holding its underlying assets. No REIT tax or distribution rule is inferred.

title: Multifamily Seller/Servicer Guide, Chapter 22, Originating a Manufactured Housing Community Mortgage
notes: Chapter definitions distinguish rental sites, homes owned by the borrower and homes owned by residents. Cited only to support the different ownership and income structures, without eligibility criteria.

title: Commercial Lending: Refinance Risk, Bulletin 2024-29
publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
notes: Risk discussion on maturities, refinancing ability and forward capacity. Applies in the bulletin's supervisory scope.

title: Multifamily Seller/Servicer Guide, Chapter 41, Transfers of Ownership
notes: Guide index linked the edition marked Guide Bulletin Update 10/20/26. Sections 41.1–41.4 distinguish property assumptions, borrower-interest transfers and consent paths. Section 41.1 discusses ownership transfers alongside supplemental originations. No specific deadline or threshold is asserted.
